listing.name: Mirrored Odyssey
listing.summary: Adds a mirrored version of the Odyssey ship with hangars on the left and main weapons on the right.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a mirrored version of the Odyssey ship with hangars on the left and main weapons on the right.

description:
Earlier today I wanted to have an Odyssey that flanked to the left to compliment the normal one that flanked to the right.

I asked on the discord, apparently nobody had done it before, so with some help from venauv and others, I did it myself.

Exactly what it says on the tin, this mod contains an Odyssey that is mirrored so the hangars are on the left, and the main weapons are on the right, and so forth.  Everything else is the same.  The normal variant still has the lousy loadout, the hitbox is still uneven at the thrusters, it has exactly the same odds of appearing in TT fleets (so... double when combined with the original), etc.

This is my first mod, so... actually I think it's pretty much fine, but please let me know if anything is messed up.
